meaningfulPartnerChallenges.resolution: A visitor can select before discovering playback, but screenshots cannot establish hesitation or failure. Keep the comfortable portrait scale and still-first default. Observe a concrete compare-performances task; only if people need coaching add a small View performance or nearby Play affordance. Do not fix this by autoplaying, stealing focus on every select change or shrinking the character back into the cramped former row.

practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.catalogIntake: Both records explicitly cover all 17 installed catalogue entries. A read emil-design-eng and mobile-native fully; B additionally read review-animations, remove-animations and break-ui. Do not imply A reread or fully executed B's additional skills.
agreedProcessFromBothIndependentRecords: Begin each interaction review with purpose and repetition frequency: operational feedback versus intentionally requested character content. Use Before/After/Why evidence rather than mechanically counting timing rules.

A owns a bounded keyboard/focus/native-select/reduced-motion/state-announcement matrix; B adds first-visit discovery and repeated-use tasks. Preserve separate scores and challenge each other after independent evidence review.

Review hover/fine/coarse input, focus-visible and reduced-motion capabilities separately from viewport widths. Preserve zoom, document scrolling and body-text selection; keep native controls unless a demonstrated requirement needs custom behavior.

At future mutable website integration, use B's break-ui workflow for actual longest labels, 320px and 200% text/zoom cases; inspect rendered outcomes. A checks resulting focus order and control semantics. Do not claim these stress cases ran in this frozen review.

Before mobile validation claims, execute real-phone tasks; before screen-reader claims, capture actual spoken ordering. Keep source, programmatic records, native input, speech and human/device observation as separate evidence tiers.
Recheck live motion-preference changes, hidden/offscreen pauses and the between-clip timer after relevant integration changes. A passing static screenshot does not cover these transitions.
exceptions: UI sub-300ms and no-keyboard-animation rules apply to feedback and navigation, not to a keyboard Play request for authored character content.
Transform/opacity guidance does not authorize deleting SVG expression changes or altering the required tiny anatomy. Profile actual cost before changing rendering.
No blanket tap-highlight removal, document overscroll lock, fixed app-shell viewport rules or global user-select:none for these scrolling documents.
Source remains frozen during independent/pair review. Construction, removal and stress-fixture skills inform future engineering work rather than mutating the artifact under review.
Skills do not supply missing audience, physical-device or assistive-technology evidence and do not create an extra local-work permission gate.
